name: alphaxiv_papers
description: Natural-language alphaXiv downloader, driven by the Rhai plugin `websites/alphaxiv.org` (kind: "plugin"). Pass a search query, a paper URL, or a trending keyword via --query (or state.query); the plugin discovers /abs/<id> papers, asks the engine to render each one until its SPA settles, and writes Markdown plus figures under out_dir (default ~/tmp/alphaxiv). Paper pages are fetched in Chinese by default (lang defaults to zh; set lang to en/off to disable). Trending saves 10 by default and pages through alphaXiv's feed API, so count can reach 500 (e.g. --state '{"count":100,"interval":"30 Days"}'). Optional state: mode (auto|search|trending|url), count, interval (3 Days|7 Days|30 Days|90 Days|All time), paper_url, out_dir, selector, lang. When a paper page has no AI Overview yet the section reads "No overview yet", so in url mode the plugin clicks the site's own Generate overview button and waits for the result (alphaXiv says about five minutes; overview_wait_ms defaults to 420000) before capturing, so the saved Markdown carries the real overview; pass generate_overview:false to skip it. Listing modes (search/trending) only do this when generate_overview:true is passed, and then only for the first overview_max_papers (default 3). Each <slug>_meta.json records a UTC downloaded_at (plus trending rank/interval) for monitoring. The site logic (mode inference, locale URLs, feed paging) lives in websites/alphaxiv.org/plugin/main.rhai, so it can change without rebuilding the engine.
